newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Top Form sees steeper loss in second half.
newsitem.headline: Top Form sees steeper loss in second half.

text.p: Underwear maker Top Form International Ltd said on Monday the loss for the second half of its fiscal year ended June 30 was expected to be materially higher than the loss incurred in its unauditied interim results.
The company also said in a statement the unaudited loss of HK$68.31 million for the six months ended December 31, 1995, was understated and may have to be adjusted.
Top Form's managing director Eddie Wong said the company was still streamlining its core manufacturing business and rationalising its non-core business activities.
"These measures involve actual or pending closures of certain operations and the making of further provisions for the group's inventory," Wong said.
An initial finding indicated that the understatement in the unaudited interim results may be material, the company said.

The understatement related to miscalculation of cost in respect of consignment stocks as the result of incorrect information generated by a new bar-coding inventory system introduced in one of its production locations, Wong said.
"The unaudited loss for the six months to December 31, 1995 may have to be adjusted," Wong said.
The financial results for the year ended June 30 will be made by the end of November, the company said.
Trading in the company shares which suspended last Friday will remain suspended pending further statement, it said.
